ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde trust & safety: preserve the chat log (F11) and driver statement; review the $6.61 cancellation fee (NS-1/NS-2 analysis below) after the conduct review; flag driver account for abusive/threatening language under A13 code of conduct. Do not auto-execute any refund until human review completes.
ruling.reasoning:
SAFETY SCREEN: Chat #3 [F11] at 09:54, sent by the driver immediately before cancelling, reads "Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it." Read in context this is not a pickup arrangement or banter — it is a threat/intimidation directed at the rider. Ryde's code of conduct bars "abuse of any kind", including "Threats and Intimidation" (Ryde 一手 A13), which is exactly the conduct SAFE-1 covers. Under SAFE-1 I must not auto-adjudicate; the case goes to a human with a factual summary. Chat record is complete and fully timestamped [F12], so the threat is not an artefact of an incomplete log.

Secondary (non-executing) fee analysis for the reviewer: the $6.61 cancellation fee charged [F7] would, on the system records, be justified — the platform recorded arrival at 09:49:50 [F5], the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 09:50:45 while 38 m from the pickup point [F1][F6], i.e. within the 200 m arrival radius, and the timeline shows the driver stayed within 200 m for 3 min 40 s after the tap [F6] (> 3 min; cancellation 4 min 35 s after arrival, [F2][F5]). That would satisfy NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) as far as the record goes, so there is no refund computed from an arithmetic shortfall on these facts. However, the driver's own pre-cancellation threat is a conduct matter that a human must weigh, and the applicability of the no-show fee is not to be executed automatically while SAFE-1 escalation is open.

Note the driver's written statement [F13] ("I waited more than 4 minutes… I cancelled as a no-show") is a claim only and plays no part in the safety finding; the finding rests on the rider-visible chat text at [F11]. No route-deviation segments exist in this case, so segment_findings is empty. Traffic/weather facts [F14][F15][F16] are irrelevant here. Profile facts [F17][F18] (driver has 1 upheld no-show dispute in 90 d) are noted but, per procedure, do not alone decide any element; the driver's prior upheld no-show dispute [F18] is for the human reviewer to consider in account action.
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-1: the driver's pre-cancellation chat message [F11] is a threat/intimidation directed at the rider. No automatic ruling is issued; the case is referred to a human reviewer with the above factual summary. The $6.61 cancellation fee analysis (NS-1 appears satisfied on system records) is provided for the reviewer but must not be executed automatically.

rejected_claims.id: rider complaint — driver 'threatened me ... and then cancelled and charged me $6.61' (fee portion)
rejected_claims.reason: The conduct/threat portion is well founded on F11 and triggers SAFE-1. The fee portion, however, is not supported by the system records: the driver tapped 'I'm Here' 38 m from pickup [F1][F6] and remained within 200 m for 3 min 40 s after the tap [F6], satisfying NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) on the record. Any waiver of the $6.61 therefore rests on conduct review by a human, not on this clause analysis.
